mapper.select: SELECT p.*, m.member_name as memberName, c.coach_name as coachName FROM plan p JOIN member m ON p.member_account = m.member_account JOIN coach c ON p.coach_account = c.coach_account

SELECT p.*, m.member_name as memberName, c.coach_name as coachName FROM plan p JOIN member m ON p.member_account = m.member_account JOIN coach c ON p.coach_account = c.coach_account WHERE p.member_account = #{memberAccount}

SELECT p.*, m.member_name as memberName, c.coach_name as coachName FROM plan p JOIN member m ON p.member_account = m.member_account JOIN coach c ON p.coach_account = c.coach_account WHERE p.coach_account = #{coachAccount}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan (member_account, coach_account, message) VALUES (#{memberAccount}, #{coachAccount}, #{message})
